name: Poppy seed
description: Tiny white or blue seeds ground into a paste to thicken korma and posto.

tcm.note: The seed is not the classical drug; thin record.

ayurveda.note: Khaskhasa is shita, heavy and mildly sedating — a cooling thickener, unusually for a spice.

unani.note: Khashkhash is barid-ratab and given to induce sleep — one of the few thanda items in the masala box.
